evidence_against: The analyst’s characterization of repeated ETH DOWN and BTC RANGE candidates as stronger evidence may overstate replication. Candidate definitions, horizons, target units, settlement rules, and outcome overlap are absent; matching titles can indicate semantic duplication rather than independent confirmation.

The five highlighted candidate counts sum to 203 matured outcomes (48+46+41+37+31), exceeding architecture health’s total of 194 matured and adjudicated outcomes. This precludes interpreting those counts as independent observations without reconciling scope and overlap.

Selection occurred across 178 lifecycle candidates and 311 forecast JSON files, but no multiple-testing correction, family-wise error control, false-discovery estimate, or prespecified candidate-selection rule is supplied. Five supportive high-N labels could therefore reflect selection from a broad search.

MATURED_SUPPORTED is only a lifecycle label. There are no effect sizes, candidate losses, confidence intervals, calibration measures, hit rates, or baseline losses from which to determine whether support is economically or statistically meaningful.

The proposed “naïve unconditional baseline” is not operationally defined. Its estimation window, information set, update policy, regime treatment, and loss function remain unspecified, allowing baseline weakness or revision drift to manufacture apparent incremental value.

No candidate-level creation timestamps, immutable specifications, source-temporal-provenance records, or no-hindsight receipts are supplied. The frozen council package does not by itself establish that candidate definitions and evaluation rules were fixed before every scored observation.

The 62 archive-only duplicates and unspecified common market episodes create dependence risk. Concurrent observations from two candidates on the same instrument may represent repeated scoring of the same event rather than additional evidence.

Registry and escalation artifacts disagree on maturation counts for EC-0dc8abd903144198e36e (48 versus 46) and EC-0e9733866b37fcec87ed (11 versus 7), while scientific-admission status is null in one artifact and QUALIFIED_FOR_FORWARD_TEST in another. These lineage differences weaken count-based prioritization.

The BTC DOWN contrast is not yet symmetric: EC-62dc79b74bb6526e7c67 has 31 outcomes while EC-8136ca63303d3ccd5605 has 10. The observed ordering could be sampling instability, differing eligibility, or regime coincidence rather than stable definitional value.

All 125 assessed workflows are AMBER, and relevant adjudication, provenance, and council workflows report NO_RUN_HISTORY and/or WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE. The evidence cannot distinguish API-visibility problems from actual execution gaps.
evidence_for: The analyst appropriately declined to ratify a predictive rule, forecast, portfolio action, threshold change, weight change, or canonical promotion.

Five named forecast tests are labeled MATURED_SUPPORTED with registry counts above the supplied 25-outcome policy minimum, making them eligible for adversarial examination even though the labels do not establish incremental value.

Experiment receipt synchronization reports PASS with zero hash mismatches, and the shadow-registry summary reports zero source-missing candidates; these are limited integrity signals rather than performance evidence.
The supplied package explicitly preserves candidates as non-canonical and non-executing and states that baseline, control, regime, and complexity review remains outstanding.
The monthly, maturation, milestone, and escalation triggers are active, supporting a research-only review despite unresolved evidence quality.
hypotheses: Conditional on recovering immutable pre-outcome specifications, each of EC-4e02e53e58c3e79ba871 and EC-5c8b675adec8111650dd will separately achieve lower mean prospective loss than the same precisely defined unconditional baseline over at least 25 new candidate-eligible, temporally forward, non-duplicate settlements per candidate. The loss function, baseline estimation window, overlap policy, and settlement rules must be frozen before observation. Falsified if either candidate fails to improve on the baseline or if improvement disappears after common-episode dependence controls.

Conditional on recovering immutable pre-outcome specifications, each of EC-0dc8abd903144198e36e and EC-23f2161a31fe1f482e99 will separately achieve lower mean prospective loss than the same precisely defined unconditional RANGE baseline over at least 25 new candidate-eligible, temporally forward, non-duplicate settlements per candidate. Falsified if either candidate has non-positive incremental improvement or if apparent improvement depends on duplicate or overlapping settlements.

On a prospectively frozen common eligible cohort of at least 25 paired settlements, BTC DOWN candidate EC-62dc79b74bb6526e7c67 will have lower mean loss than EC-8136ca63303d3ccd5605 under one preregistered scoring rule. Falsified if no common cohort can be defined without revising either candidate, if the loss difference is non-positive, or if the ordering is attributable to duplicated settlements.
summary: The analyst’s refusal to ratify a market rule survives adversarial review, but the claim that repeated ETH DOWN and BTC RANGE candidates constitute stronger evidence does not yet survive. Their apparent replication may be semantic and outcome-dependent: the five highlighted counts total 203, already exceeding the architecture-wide total of 194 matured and adjudicated outcomes. Broad candidate selection, missing effect sizes and baselines, unresolved lineage discrepancies, absent no-hindsight documentation, and workflow visibility warnings prevent a predictive learning claim. The named candidates remain bounded research objects suitable only for fresh candidate-level tests with frozen specifications, exact baselines, duplicate controls, and non-overlapping prospective observations.
uncertainties: It is unknown whether identically titled candidates differ in horizon, target magnitude, data source, eligibility rule, settlement rule, or scoring method.
The relationship among 286 outcome JSON files, a matured-outcome delta of 286, and 194 matured/adjudicated outcomes is unresolved.
Outcome-level overlap cannot be measured from the supplied candidate aggregates, and the five high-N counts exceeding 194 may reflect overlap, scope differences, or inconsistent snapshots.
No supplied record establishes when each candidate specification was frozen relative to its scored observations, so hindsight leakage cannot be excluded.
The statistical meaning of MATURED_SUPPORTED and MATURED_NOT_SUPPORTED is unspecified, including whether labels incorporate multiplicity or dependence.
Regime coverage, market-episode concentration, and effective sample sizes are unknown.
Automation warnings may represent unavailable API registration rather than non-execution; operational reliability therefore remains indeterminate.
No supplied evidence connects forecast-test performance to execution feasibility, costs, portfolio utility, or causal mechanism.
